quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson details the recovery process from his off-season surgery
quotes.excerpt: I had nine different casts. I was able to take it off and if I ran or worked out with it.
quotes.quote: Taking my cast off was the highlight of my off-season. It was on for six weeks. I had nine different casts. I was able to take it off and if I ran or worked out with it. So I had one for like workouts, one for like showering, and obviously one for the everyday use. I had nine because they got gross.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson explains his reaction during the airport massage chair skit
quotes.excerpt: I was just trying not to burst out laughing. That was my sole goal of that skit.
quotes.quote: That was funny. I was just trying not to burst out laughing. That was my sole goal of that skit. He was going insane. I just kept saying, look at me. I was like, I'm not looking that way. I was either going to close my eyes or continue to look straight, but that was one of my favorites just because I was so focused on not trying to burst out laughing because I knew I would mess up everything else.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson discusses the editing process for the Roommates Show
quotes.excerpt: You'd be surprised at how much stuff gets cut. It wouldn't be like get, it could be skits.
quotes.quote: A lot gets cut. One of my favorites was Young Rell school when I was at the rapper. It got posted later because we did it through dress rehearsal. That got cut because also I think it had the most time and so for the live show, obviously, you need to be within the time period of the time slot. You'd be surprised at how much stuff gets cut. It wouldn't be like get, it could be skits, but like the timing of everything. Hey, we need to cut these these words out or this line out. A lot of things get cut literally every second.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on maintaining team mentality after a successful season
quotes.excerpt: We have to kind of act like we didn't win anything. Like that's over. Page has turned.
quotes.quote: The mentality kind of has to be like the same. Just because like you said, Josh, Josh has said that we won last year has nothing to do with this year. Like we have to kind of act like we didn't win anything. Like that's over. Page has turned. We can use that experience, but we just don't want to sit there and be like, hey, like, you know, we won last year, we're going to just snap our fingers and we're going to do it again. That's not how it's going to work at all. I think as an approach from a team aspect, we just kind of have to hold each other accountable thinking that this is a brand new year.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the dedication required to win in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: We know what it takes to win in terms of the sacrifice, the attention to detail.
quotes.quote: We know what it takes to win in terms of the sacrifice, the attention to detail, all those kind of things. So we can channel that experience as long as we don't just think, oh, we're just we're just coasting and we're just we did it before, so we'll just do it again. It's a one thing where it's like you have to continue to build that attention to detail and that focus every day. And now you know what it takes to win and you and you realize how hard that is, and you know that you have to chip away, you know, every single day, whether it's practice, whether it's games.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart identifies the toughest Villanova teammate in one-on-one
quotes.excerpt: We had a lot of skilled guards in that, so I'll say it would probably have to be a big.
quotes.quote: We had a lot of skilled guards in that, so I'll say it would probably have to be a big. Tim Delaney. He had bad hips. He had to get two hip replacements at like 18. That's rough. So I'm cooking him.
